# Reference attribution

Thomas Fischbacher, *Life at the Boundary of Chemical Kinetics and Program Execution*.
Physical Review E 112, 035309 (2025), DOI: 10.1103/dyzr-m21s.

Reference code: Copyright 2025 Google LLC; Apache License, Version 2.0.
Original repository: https://github.com/paradigms-of-intelligence/chemical-kinetics-and-program-execution
User-selected fork: https://github.com/notationsystems/Chemical-Kinetics-and-Program-Execution
Pinned reference commit: `8063d68d4f4c0c4ad751deeb27afd3bfb104c156`.

`src/ciw/sequence_kinetics.py` is a bounded adaptation of the sequence-probability,
context-transition and entropy concepts in `framework/markov_tapes.py`, with a
separate elementary independent-site kinetic benchmark. It is not a copy or
qualified replacement for the Scheme interaction framework. The original helper
functions, compiled native library and Scheme/JAX runtimes are not imported or
executed. NET-specific validation, support semantics, bounded representation,
analytic independent-site propagation, workflow and tests are new work.

The retained LICENSE bytes match the reference repository LICENSE Git blob
`d645695673349e3947e8e5ae42332d0ac3164cd7` (11358 bytes). NET's root license and
third-party source/data rights are not changed by this integration.
